title: Arcinite Mod
description: A mod that adds a new ore type
body:
This is the first mod I have made.

This mod adds a new material, Arcinite. It is similar to netherite but weaker and faster. Kind of like a late game version of gold tools. It also adds a couple other things, some of them unobtainable in survival because this was my first mod and I was experimenting.
